name: Example table: pedestrians per hour
description: Pedestrians counted per hour on four streets, on weekdays and on weekends: the mean count of the days, and their low and high counts. One of nine example tables that illustrate ways to chart a comparison of scenarios, each row's scenario in its case column. The Nine ways to chart scenario comparisons test dataflow draws it as lines with a band, one panel per street. Curio's seeded script scripts/build_example_scenario_charts.py writes it.
